newsitem.title: USA: ST PAUL CATTLE TRADE $0.50/1.00 HIGHER - USDA.
newsitem.headline: ST PAUL CATTLE TRADE $0.50/1.00 HIGHER - USDA.

text.p: Compared to Monday, a good offering of slaughter steers and heifers sold $0.50-1.00 higher. - USDA

Slaughter Steers: Choice 2-4 1125-1475 lbs 63.50-65.10, package mostly black 1336 lbs 65.40. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1425 lbs 62.00-64.00. Select 2-3 1000-1375 lbs 59.0-62.50, package thin Crossbred 63.10.
Slaughter Heifers: Choice 2-4 1000-1350 lbs 62.85-64.25, package black 1131 lbs 64.60. Select and Choice 2-3 950-1350 lbs 60.00-62.85. Few select 2-3 1100-1590 lbs 56.50-60.00.
